duster.headline: Diesel-auto supply thin; best full-criteria fit is 2022 TechRoad Auto at KIA Ballito; biggest value is a manual 2022 Zen.

shortlist.note: 2022 TechRoad diesel auto, 47 051 km, R249 900, +R12.2k — only listing meeting auto+2020+diesel.
Cheapest diesel auto: 2019 Dynamique, 88 500 km, R195 000, +R5.7k; pre-2020 caveat.
Standout +R24.3k: 2022 Zen diesel, 72 000 km, R209 990 — but manual.

caddy.headline: Only one Caddy within caps in KZN right now; 2020 Crew Bus fits both caps — inspect quickly before it's gone.

shortlist.note: 2020 1.6 Crew Bus, 76 000 km, R279 990 — within R300k/100k caps; sole option, verify history.

alerts.line: Sole listing — book inspection before it sells.

jimny.headline: Three 3-door Jimnys under caps, no 5-doors listed; cheapest viable is 2018 1.3 at R234 890.

shortlist.note: Cheapest: 2018 1.3, 86 000 km, R234 890 — older gen, budget for checks.
2020 1.5 GLX AllGrip, 78 000 km, R289 890 — newer gen, near price cap.
2021 GLX AllGrip, 25 115 km, R295 995 — lowest km, just under cap.

seltos.headline: Strong buyer's market: 2021 EX Auto at R210 000 sits R37.7k under model price; most diesels overpriced.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.6 EX Auto, 100 000 km, R210 000, +R37.7k — cheapest auto; GAC group takes trades.
2023 EX Auto, 44 000 km, R274 990, +R26.9k — newest low-km pick.
2021 1.5CRDi EX+ Auto, 56 000 km, R279 990, +R12.3k — best diesel-auto fit.

creta.headline: Gen2 diesel autos scarce; best value is 2024 Premium Auto at R279 999 (+R26.4k); avoid gen1 2019-early-2020 cars.

shortlist.note: 2024 1.5 Premium Auto, 40 000 km, R279 999, +R26.4k — newest, gen2, low km.
2021 1.6D Executive Auto, 98 000 km, R249 990, +R15.8k — diesel auto, high km.
2021 1.5 Premium manual, 81 000 km, R199 990, +R33.7k — biggest bargain, wrong gearbox.

hr-v.headline: Thin market: two old-gen CVTs; 2021 Comfort at R249,990/57k km is the value pick with 448 L boot and Magic Seats.

shortlist.note: 2021 Comfort CVT, 57,000 km, R249,990 — old gen: 448 L boot, Magic Seats.
2020 1.8 Elegance, 50,000 km, R298,990 — R49k premium for 7k fewer km.

corolla-cross.headline: Strong XS value at the cap's floor: two 2021 XS autos under model price; near-new 2024 Xi needs verification.

shortlist.note: 2021 XS, 36,300 km, R249,990 — R20,200 under model; best value, petrol non-hybrid.
2021 XS, 29,000 km, R249,999 — R17,488 under; lowest-km XS in cap.
2024 XS, 42,342 km, R269,990 — R17,109 under; newest XS, full spec.

alerts.line: Near-new 2024 Xi at R259,990: verify history carefully

mg-zs.headline: All facelift 443 L units; 2026 Comfort at R249,900 undercuts market; best Luxury deal lacks dealer — verify warranty transfer.

shortlist.note: 2026 Comfort, 9,906 km, R249,900 — R17,809 under; cheapest, dealer-backed, warranty intact.
2026 Luxury, 5,000 km, R269,900 — R18,922 under; no dealer listed, verify seller.
2026 Comfort, 14,700 km, R249,950 — R8,681 under; CMH Kempster backup option.

alerts.line: No dealer shown — confirm warranty transfer

haval-h6.headline: Skip the 2019 manual; 2022 2.0T Premium at GWM Hillcrest (R279,990/51k km) is the trade-friendly pick.

shortlist.note: 2022 2.0T Premium, 51,300 km, R279,990 — GWM dealer ideal for Duster trade; check warranty.
2025 2.0GDIT Premium, 40,000 km, R299,900 — newest, likely full 5-yr warranty.
2022 2.0T Luxury, 66,100 km, R289,990 — Chery dealer, higher km.

peugeot-2008.headline: Gen2 6ATs only; 2022 Allure at R229,990 is cheapest entry, but wet-belt service history decides everything.

shortlist.note: 2022 Allure, 55,000 km, R229,990 — cheapest; demand wet-belt service proof.
2024 Active, 30,000 km, R239,950 — newer, low km, R10k more.
2025 Active, 32,000 km, R259,950 — freshest low-km option.

proton-x70.headline: First capture: seven X70s, 65-81k km, R209,899-R284,999; 2023 Standard at R209,899 anchors value — inspect wet-DCT heat, trade Duster at CMH.

shortlist.note: 2023 Standard, R209,899, 68,100 km — R20k under next Standard, estUnder ~+R23k; test DCT in traffic.
2022 Executive AWD, R239,900, 66,500 km — cheapest, lowest-km Executive; AWD suits Duster 4x4 swap.
2023 Premium X, R284,990, 65,300 km — top trim, lowest km, but R45k over Executive; non-CMH trade.

discovery.headline: Only MG ZS (443 L) clears the 430 L bar; add Omoda C5 solely for 2025+ X Series trims; others fail or unverified.

shortlist.note: 443 L clears bar; all 6 listings autos, within budget; verify MG dealer network and reliability.
Standard 378 L fails; only 2025+ X Series (442 L) qualifies — filter listings accordingly.
